0707.notes: The only closed red loop is the 10-12 Div. teardrop near Minsk. Red curves and arrows around Polotsk/Sirotino (28.3-29.8E, 55.1-55.5N) are open and sit east of the front signs there, so not counted. Red open arc 'Nachhuten' (rotated, ~26.2-26.5E, 50.8-51.6N) is open, no outline. 'Versprengte Feindteile' (red text, no outline) in the Pripyat marshes at ~27.0-28.7E, 52.5N. 1.K.D. now at about 29.6E 52.98N and 'Tle.1.K.D.' near 29.0E, both west of 3.Pz.; not listed. 29.m. appears here on the Minsk-Borisov road as a front sign.
